svg.title: CL-04 concept layout drawing
svg.text: 1. Concept layout for review and alignment. Placeholder geometry: not a design, not for manufacture.
2. Dimensions in millimetres; scale 1:50 on a 420 × 297 mm sheet. Third-angle projection.
3. Centre of gravity uses placeholder effective densities (cad/params/common.yaml).
4. Static margin: shortest distance from CG to the support-polygon edge; tip angle = atan(margin / CG height).
5. Docked rotor to pilot 920; UAV drawn in blue; 1.75 m person in grey.
⚠ static margin 225 mm is under the 300 mm review flag
⚠ docked rotor 920 mm from the pilot: under the 1000 mm flag
CL-04 · Biped armoured pod, seated cockpit, rear dock

g.text: Terms: AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · CC = Creative Commons; CC BY 4.0 is the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence used for the documentation · CG = centre of gravity · CL-nnn = concept layout

(cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-CAD-001 = the concept layouts document (cad/README.md); its
drawing sheets are SUS-CAD-001-CL-nn · SUS-I1 = integrated mechanized walker and observation UAV · SUS-M1 = piloted walker · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
